content: VPN not connecting after Windows update
resolution: Uninstalled Cisco Secure Client, reinstalled v5.0.04032, restarted. Fixed.

content: Outlook not syncing emails, stuck on loading
resolution: Cleared OST cache file at AppData/Local/Microsoft/Outlook. Restarted Outlook. Fixed.

content: Printer shows offline even though it's on
resolution: Removed printer, re-added via IP address 192.168.1.105. Updated driver from HP website. Fixed.

content: Laptop battery draining very fast, overheating on idle
resolution: Disabled background apps in Task Manager, updated BIOS firmware. Battery calibrated. Fixed.

content: Cannot access company SharePoint, getting access denied error
resolution: Re-authenticated Microsoft 365 account, cleared browser cache, re-added site to trusted zones. Fixed.

content: How many paid leaves do I have remaining?
resolution: Directed to HR portal at hr.company.com, under Leave Balance section. 8 PL remaining.

content: Production API down, 500 errors on all endpoints
resolution: Database connection pool exhausted due to a query leak in the new release. Rolled back v2.3.1, increased pool size to 50. Fixed in 23 minutes.

content: VPN not connecting after Windows update
resolution:
This matches Ravi's incident from 2025-06-02. This is a recurring issue.

1.  Uninstall Cisco Secure Client.
2.  Reinstall Cisco Secure Client v5.0.04032.
3.  Restart your computer.

If the issue persists, please reply to this thread.
